main_text.head: DE REPVBLICA ATHENIENSIVM.

head.i: Status regionis & populi Attici primis Regibus ante Theseum, & sub Thesco.

main_text.p: ATHENAE, ut ab his ordiamur, à Cecrope viro Ægyptio in regione Attică primum conditæ sunt, ubi post summa urbs & urbi, arx fuit, juxta amnéldissum[?], non procul quidem mari, nec tamen ad mare sitæ novi regni caput, & regis sedes: totaq; regio Attica in varios populos & vicos hactenus sparsa in oppida præcipua xi[?] ab eodem contracta, quorum singula sub regibus sequentibus suas curias, suosque magistratus & ordinem civilem habuêre, membra tamen regni unius, & uni regi parentia. Sed potestas regum minimeherilis[?] & indefinita fuit, ut quicquid ipsis liberet, id vim juris in populo, & parendi necessitatem habe-

page.notes: Show-through from the facing page (mirrored red and grey fragments in the right margin, and at the bottom right) is not transcribed. No running head or page number is printed. "amnéldissum" is uncertain. "xi" at the end of the line "præcipua" is doubtful and may be a stray marginal mark. "minimeherilis" is uncertain. The paragraph breaks off mid-word ("habe-") and continues on the next page.
